subject: [PATCH v2 0/6] nfsd: add new export options for controlling read/write iomode

reviews.author: Chuck Lever
reviews.summary: Applied the patches to nfsd-testing with minor logic tweaks for saner handling of splice reads and renaming options as requested. No further comments or concerns raised.
reviews.raw_body:
On Thu, 29 Oct 2026 08:05:13 -0400, Jeff Layton wrote:
> This version has the changes that Chuck requested. Most of it is minor
> logic tweaks for saner handling of splice reads, and renaming the
> options to read_io=/write_io=. I'll also be sending a v2 of the nfs-utils
> patchset. Original cover letter follows:
> 
> When we originally added support for the dontcache and direct iomodes to
> nfsd, we added global debugfs switches to control them. That was fine for
> experimentation but the goal was always to move these controls to
> something more permanent.
> 
> [...]

Applied to nfsd-testing, thanks!

2026-10-30.patch_summary: This patch series adds new export options to the NFS server (nfsd) for controlling read and write I/O modes on a per-export basis, replacing global debugfs switches. The options are read_io= and write_io=, which can be set to buffered, direct, or dontcache. This change aims to provide more fine-grained control over I/O behavior and eventually move these controls to something more permanent.
